aggregation: Each CVaR is computed within one seed and then averaged across seeds; latency quantiles pool actual executions as diagnostics.
corruption_scope: Diagnostic preregistered input strata; small within-stratum source counts are reported and no subgroup superiority decision is issued.

audit.independence: disjoint source pool and parameters; same local host

reward.independence: disjoint source pool and parameters; same local host

paired_replay_timings.scope: Complete paired replay census; wall includes writing, reopening and audit observation; timings are descriptive of these executions, not independent randomized hardware benchmarks.

small_seed_warning: Training-seed count is small; seed means are descriptive. Rows and repeated source cases are not independent training replicates.

strong_paired_contrasts.interval_scope: Simultaneous bounded-loss interval ONLY if original source cases are independent draws, conditional on all frozen trained models; no coverage for training-seed uncertainty.
